data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Flin was a name given to the torch bearers who accompanied the god Hermes during his nightly travels. The name carries the symbolism of illumination, guidance, and protection. The name Flin carries the meaning “Torch bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Flin usually hope their child will grow to embody torch bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
